name_reason: Matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. '14' is the chapter ID (valid 01-30 range, a meaningful domain ID), not an address residual. Name accurately reflects the function's role as the chapter 14 end handler.
purpose: Chapter 14 (平原的會戰) end handler: pure post-battle scene + dialog + cutscene closer (no char recruited), then advances current_chapter_id.
logic_summary: Stack-check probe __CHK(0x68). Copies three 16-byte scene tables (post-battle char X / Y / facing @ 0x52153 / 0x52163 / 0x52173) onto stack placement blocks via REP MOVSD (4 dwords each). Refreshes portrait cache for race 1 (fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1)). Stages the post-battle scene via fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro(x, y, facing, 0, 0xf, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0xc, 10) -- place chars 0..0xF, no extra char (extra idx 0 at (0,0) facing 0), camera origin (0xC,10). Plays cutscene: dialog page 2; battle_anim_phase = 0; cutscene event 0x2F; dialog page 3. Persists party runtime-char state (fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template), then INC current_chapter_id. In the binary the body carries two mid-function tail-jump targets reused by siblings: 0x239AC (save; INC; RET) <- fd2_chapter_22_end, 0x239B1 (INC; RET) <- fd2_chapter_12_end; chapter 14 is emitted self-contained (Layer 2 functional equivalence, jump-into-middle sharing not preserved in source).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: stages on-screen scene, plays dialog/cutscene, persists runtime chars to template store, increments data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id.
